axi_ram_wr_if.summary: AXI write-to-RAM command adapter: 3-state FSM accepts an AW burst, generates incrementing RAM write commands per W beat, then issues the B response.

blocks.name: write_fsm
blocks.description: Idle/burst/response FSM controlling AW accept, beat handling and response.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: FSM idle/burst/response sequencing address accept, data beats and write response.

anchors.name: write_addr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Burst active flag gating wready and RAM write enable.

anchors.name: write_last_reg
anchors.why: Marks last beat of burst, drives ram_wr_cmd_last.

blocks.name: burst_address_gen
blocks.description: Latches AW parameters, increments address and counts remaining beats.

anchors.name: write_addr_reg
anchors.why: Current burst address, incremented by transfer size per beat.

anchors.name: write_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beat count loaded from awlen; decides burst end.

anchors.name: write_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched clamped transfer size setting address increment.

anchors.name: write_burst_reg
anchors.why: Burst type; fixed burst disables address increment.

anchors.name: write_id_reg
anchors.why: Latched AW id driven on RAM command and copied to bid.

blocks.name: axi_slave_port
blocks.description: AXI AW, W and B channel handshakes.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AW valid; with ready latches burst address and parameters.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW ready asserted in idle state by registered FSM output.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Burst start address loaded into write address register.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data passed straight through to RAM command data.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: W beat valid; generates RAM write enable and advances burst.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: W ready when address valid and RAM ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid after final beat, held until bready.

anchors.name: s_axi_bready
anchors.why: Response ready clearing bvalid and allowing FSM to return idle.

blocks.name: ram_cmd_port
blocks.description: RAM write command outputs with ready backpressure.

anchors.name: ram_wr_cmd_addr
anchors.why: RAM write address from burst address register.

anchors.name: ram_wr_cmd_data
anchors.why: RAM write data from AXI W channel.

anchors.name: ram_wr_cmd_en
anchors.why: RAM write command enable when address valid and wvalid.

anchors.name: ram_wr_cmd_ready
anchors.why: RAM ready gating AXI wready.

axi_ram_rd_if.summary: AXI read-to-RAM adapter: an idle/burst FSM latches the AR request and issues one RAM read command per beat with incrementing address and beat counter, while RAM responses pass to the AXI R channel through an optional pipeline register.

blocks.name: Burst controller
blocks.description: FSM accepting AR and counting beats of the RAM read burst.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Idle/burst FSM accepting AR requests and sequencing per-beat RAM commands.

anchors.name: read_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beats in burst, loaded from arlen; ends burst at zero.

anchors.name: read_last_reg
anchors.why: Marks last beat of burst on RAM command.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AR request valid starting a burst in idle.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR ready, high in idle until request accepted.

blocks.name: Address generator
blocks.description: Holds request attributes and increments address per beat.

anchors.name: read_addr_reg
anchors.why: Current beat address, incremented by size each accepted command.

anchors.name: read_burst_reg
anchors.why: Latched burst type controlling address increment.

anchors.name: read_size_reg
anchors.why: Clamped beat size used as address increment step.

anchors.name: read_id_reg
anchors.why: Latched transaction ID driving RAM command ID.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst start address latched into read_addr_reg.

blocks.name: RAM command port
blocks.description: Issues per-beat RAM read commands with valid/ready.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_en
anchors.why: RAM read command valid driven by read_addr_valid_reg.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_ready
anchors.why: RAM command ready advancing address and beat count.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_addr
anchors.why: RAM read command address output.

blocks.name: Read response path
blocks.description: Forwards RAM responses to AXI R, optionally via pipeline registers.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_data
anchors.why: RAM read response data forwarded to AXI R channel.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_valid
anchors.why: RAM response valid forwarded as s_axi_rvalid.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data from RAM response or pipeline register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: AXI R ready backpressuring RAM responses and pipeline register.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_ready
anchors.why: Response ready to RAM from s_axi_rready or empty pipe.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Optional output pipeline data register, unused when PIPELINE_OUTPUT=0.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Optional output pipeline valid register.

axi_ram_wr_rd_if.summary: AXI slave to single-port RAM command adapter: separate write and read adapter children generate RAM commands, and an arbiter tracking last grant and open bursts muxes them onto one shared command port.

blocks.name: Command arbiter
blocks.description: Grants shared RAM command port to read or write adapter with alternating priority and burst locking.

anchors.name: last_read_reg
anchors.why: Remembers whether last granted command was read; alternates priority between read and write.

anchors.name: transaction_reg
anchors.why: Burst in progress flag; locks grant to current side until last beat when not interleaving.

anchors.name: ram_cmd_rd_en
anchors.why: Read grant; selects read versus write command fields onto the shared RAM command bus.

anchors.name: ram_cmd_wr_en
anchors.why: Write grant driving RAM write enable from arbiter write_en.

anchors.name: write_eligible
anchors.why: Write request with RAM ready; candidate for write grant.

anchors.name: read_eligible
anchors.why: Read request with RAM ready; candidate for read grant.

anchors.name: ram_wr_cmd_ready
anchors.why: Ready back to write adapter when write granted.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_ready
anchors.why: Ready back to read adapter when read granted.

anchors.name: ram_wr_cmd_en
anchors.why: Write adapter command request into the arbiter.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_en
anchors.why: Read adapter command request into the arbiter.

blocks.name: RAM command mux
blocks.description: Muxes read or write command fields onto the RAM command interface by ram_cmd_rd_en.

anchors.name: ram_cmd_addr
anchors.why: Shared RAM command address muxed from read or write adapter.

anchors.name: ram_cmd_wr_data
anchors.why: RAM write data from the write adapter child.

anchors.name: ram_cmd_ready
anchors.why: RAM command ready; qualifies eligibility and returned to granted adapter.

blocks.name: AXI write adapter
blocks.description: axi_ram_wr_if child converting AW/W bursts to RAM write commands and B responses.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data channel payload into write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid into write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid from write adapter.

blocks.name: AXI read adapter
blocks.description: axi_ram_rd_if child converting AR bursts to RAM read commands and returning R data.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data channel payload from read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid into read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read data valid from read adapter.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_data
anchors.why: RAM read response data passed to the read adapter R channel.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_valid
anchors.why: RAM read response valid into read adapter.

axi_dp_ram.summary: True dual-port AXI RAM: two axi_ram_wr_rd_if adapters convert AXI bursts into RAM commands, each served by its own clock domain on a shared byte-strobed memory array with registered read responses.

blocks.name: Port A AXI adapter
blocks.description: a_if converts port A AXI bursts into RAM read/write commands.

anchors.name: s_axi_a_rdata
anchors.why: Port A AXI read data output from adapter a_if.

anchors.name: s_axi_a_wdata
anchors.why: Port A AXI write data into adapter a_if.

anchors.name: ram_a_cmd_rd_en
anchors.why: Port A read command enable; loads read response registers from mem.

anchors.name: ram_a_cmd_wr_en
anchors.why: Port A write command enable; writes strobed bytes into mem.

blocks.name: Port B AXI adapter
blocks.description: b_if converts port B AXI bursts into RAM read/write commands.

anchors.name: s_axi_b_rdata
anchors.why: Port B AXI read data output from adapter b_if.

anchors.name: s_axi_b_wdata
anchors.why: Port B AXI write data into adapter b_if.

anchors.name: ram_b_cmd_rd_en
anchors.why: Port B read command enable; loads read response registers from mem.

anchors.name: ram_b_cmd_wr_en
anchors.why: Port B write command enable; writes strobed bytes into mem.

blocks.name: Dual-port RAM array
blocks.description: Shared memory with per-port word index and byte strobed writes.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Shared word-addressed RAM array written and read by both ports.

anchors.name: addr_a_valid
anchors.why: Port A word index into mem derived from command address.

anchors.name: addr_b_valid
anchors.why: Port B word index into mem derived from command address.

anchors.name: ram_a_cmd_wr_strb
anchors.why: Port A per-byte write strobes gating mem byte lanes.

anchors.name: ram_b_cmd_wr_strb
anchors.why: Port B per-byte write strobes gating mem byte lanes.

blocks.name: Port A read response
blocks.description: Registers port A read id, data, last and valid with ready backpressure.

anchors.name: ram_a_cmd_ready
anchors.why: Port A command ready when response slot free; gates read and write.

anchors.name: ram_a_rd_resp_valid_reg
anchors.why: Port A read response valid back to adapter a_if.

anchors.name: ram_a_rd_resp_data_reg
anchors.why: Port A registered read data from mem to adapter.

blocks.name: Port B read response
blocks.description: Registers port B read id, data, last and valid with ready backpressure.

anchors.name: ram_b_cmd_ready
anchors.why: Port B command ready when response slot free; gates read and write.

anchors.name: ram_b_rd_resp_valid_reg
anchors.why: Port B read response valid back to adapter b_if.

anchors.name: ram_b_rd_resp_data_reg
anchors.why: Port B registered read data from mem to adapter.
